children: Destination XL Group reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 results with sales of $111.6 million and net income of $2.0 million, or $0.04 per diluted share. Adjusted net income was $0.05 per diluted share and adjusted EBITDA was $7.7 million for the quarter. Total cash and investments were $20.1 million at August 1, 2026, with no outstanding debt.
Revenue: Total sales of $111.6 million for Q2 fiscal 2026, down 3.4% from $115.5 million a year earlier.
Gross profit: $53.41 million for the quarter; gross margin (inclusive of occupancy) 47.9% versus 45.2% in prior-year quarter.
Operating income: $1.94 million for the quarter.
Net income: $2.0 million, or $0.04 per diluted share; compared with a net loss of $0.3 million in Q2 fiscal 2025.
Non-GAAP results: Adjusted net income of $0.05 per diluted share and adjusted EBITDA of $7.7 million for the quarter.
Comparable sales: Decrease of 3.5% for the quarter, with sequential monthly improvement—May down 5.7%, June down 2.8%, July down 1.9%.
Channel mix: Direct (digital) sales were $30.9 million, representing 27.8% of sales and performing better than stores (store comp down 4.3%, direct comp down 1.6%).
FiTMAP adoption: Fit technology available in 188 stores; over 150,000 customer engagements with early indicators of higher conversion, AOV and lower returns among users.
AI initiatives: Launched projects to improve product data, item attributes and integration of product/pricing/inventory for AI-driven discovery and commerce applications.

Strategic actions and merger update: Board determined the proposed merger with FullBeauty is no longer advisable on current terms and recommends stockholders vote against the issuance proposal; Amendment No.1 to the Preliminary Proxy Statement filed 9/2/2026.
